title: Function coverage for Return Bus Exception Error Count
purpose: Exercise the diagnostics parser path for the documented subfunction that returns the number of exception responses while preserving canonical Modbus/TCP framing.

messages.label: diagnostics request - return bus exception error count

expected_behavior: A compliant server that supports Diagnostics should process function 0x08 subfunction 0x000d and return the current bus exception error count, or respond with an exception if unsupported in this profile.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length field 0x0006 matches unit identifier plus 5-byte PDU
PDU order preserved as function 0x08, subfunction, data
Data field kept as a 2-byte value for diagnostics framing
issue_safety_notes: PK-only valid request; no issue payloads, malformed lengths, or historical exploit analogues.
